articles.title: Australia, Solomon Islands Sign Landmark Security Pact, Name Canberra 'Primary Security Partner' Amid China Deal Uncertainty
articles.description: Australia and Solomon Islands have signed a new security pact naming Canberra as Honiara's primary security partner and ruling out foreign military bases. The deal comes amid reports that the Solomons may not renew its security agreement with China in 2027.
